title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Plugin parameters. The Plugin settings manager group below is required: until a group is selected here, the plugin runs in read-only mode and refuses all write requests. This protects newly installed projects from accidental misconfiguration.

settingsManagerGroup.title: Plugin settings manager group (required)
settingsManagerGroup.description: Select a YouTrack user group whose members are allowed to open the plugin's «Plugin settings» panel and change its configuration. While this field is empty, the plugin denies all write actions by default. Only project administrators can set this value — it cannot be changed from inside the plugin itself, which keeps freshly installed projects secure until you explicitly choose who is allowed to configure them.

enableDebugLog.title: Verbose logging (diagnostics only)
enableDebugLog.description: When enabled, the plugin writes detailed diagnostic information to the YouTrack server log. Use this only when investigating an incident — the logs can include dumps of internal data structures and grow quickly. Disable in normal operation.
